Peter Svenningsen (also referred to as Peter Olsen Svenningsen) is a Danish medical professional who serves as the Chief Physician (*Cheflæge*) at the Department of Surgery at Nordsjællands Hospital in the Capital Region of Denmark [^src1] [^src2]. He holds the fellowship designation F.E.B.S EmSurg (Fellow of the European Board of Surgery in Emergency Surgery) [^src1]. 

In the context of national healthcare quality monitoring, Svenningsen plays a pivotal leadership role as the Chairman of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] [^src1]. This database is a national Danish clinical quality database under the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), focusing on the treatment quality and outcomes of acute, high-risk abdominal surgical patients. As chairman, his position and clinical expertise support the database's clinical credibility, standardization efforts, and managerial governance [^src1].

Furthermore, Svenningsen is a formal member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe|akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] (steering group) for the database [^src2]. In this capacity, he is listed alongside other regional and interdisciplinary representatives who oversee the database's strategic direction, indicator evaluation, and quality initiatives [^src2]. He is also noted as the Chairman of the Danish Surgical Society (*Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab*) [^src2]. Through these overlapping roles, Svenningsen is a central figure in the governance, clinical auditing, and standardization of acute abdominal surgery in Denmark.
